location.provenance: Be It Enacted by the People of the State of Oregon:

date.provenance: SECTION 9. (1) Sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act and the amendments to ORS 459.995 by section 8 of this 2023 Act become operative on January 1, 2025.

pfas_definition.provenance: (3) 'Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance' means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
